reason: The HSNA FAQ describes only a requirement to deliver a rights notice with the notice to quit and to file a copy with the City. It is a notification rule, not a limit on the reasons for eviction (rule 4).

rule.title: Housing Stability Notification Act: notice of tenants' rights with notice to quit
rule.requirement: When a landlord serves a notice to quit or a notice that your lease will not be renewed, they must give you a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time. The landlord must also send a copy of the notice to the City's Office of Housing Stability.
rule.requirement_es: Cuando el propietario le entrega un aviso de desalojo o un aviso de que no renovará su contrato, debe darle al mismo tiempo un Aviso de Derechos y Recursos de los Inquilinos. El propietario también debe enviar una copia del aviso a la Oficina de Estabilidad de Vivienda de la Ciudad.
rule.key_value: Rights notice must accompany notice to quit
rule.coverage_text: All landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy in Boston.

exemptions.label: Hospital, skilled nursing or health facility

all.value_text: Residence in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility
Residence in a non-profit facility for short-term substance abuse treatment

rule.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day
rule.quote:
